svg.title: SynlysAI Engineering Command Center
svg.desc: Command-center style analytics for SynlysAI public GitHub repositories, including contributor radar, repository pulse, language footprint, issue and PR flow, release lane, and roadmap state.
svg.text: Where AI meets lab automation to supercharge materials science.
Jupyter Notebook is the dominant language
Repository badges, commit pressure, and operating capability flags.
Byte-weighted code distribution across tracked repositories.
Rolling 12-week commit signal rendered as a live operations trace.
Latest public collaboration events across repository surfaces.
Latest release artifacts and milestone intent from public repository data.
Telemetry source: GitHub public REST API. People panels reflect public contributors; hidden organization membership is not available from public endpoints.
